backends.description: Local CPU Laya, an English-only 421M decision model. Prefer for short, straightforward English classification, sentiment, intent, explicit yes/no facts, and simple ordinal rubrics. Runs on this machine. At most 16 questions; Choice/Score require at least 2 options. Each option must fit 48 tokenizer tokens, the question head 192 tokens, and the full question plus state 512 tokens. Literal [MASK] tokens are unsupported. Not suitable for non-English text, long inputs, multi-step reasoning, arithmetic, subtle comparisons, or complex structured rubrics.

Hosted TypeSafe Jev. Prefer for non-English or multilingual text, longer inputs, multi-step reasoning, arithmetic, subtle comparisons, and nuanced or complex structured rubrics. Use the local model for straightforward short English decisions it can handle.
